channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dylan Harper | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dylan Harper from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Dylan Harper
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Wemby on Harper starting tonight:

“That worked out. It's not like we hadn't done it before. In practice, of course, we worked on it. Yeah, that worked out.”

Victor Wembanyama on Dylan Harper, Oct 9, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Brian Wright on De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper
item.description:
More from Brian Wright on Dylan Harper and De'Aaron Fox:

“They're are a tough matchup. We'll continue to put them in situations for them to be at their best... They'll learn from this year on how they continue to play off one another and support one another and go from there.”

Brian Wright on De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper, Jun 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Dylan Harper
item.description:
Joel Lorenzi:Alex Caruso on when he felt San Antonio could be a real threat to OKC:

“I didn't speculate just because so much happens in the course of the season, you know? One injury changes the team's entire season. (It's) the reason the Spurs got Dylan Harper. Wemby missed a whole bunch of games with the leg stuff. Sometimes you need the course of NBA seasons to shape up and see what the future is going to be. You can't always predict that.”

Alex Caruso on Dylan Harper, May 31, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:No update from Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox and Dylan Harper after their game efforts to play through obvious pain:

“I'm sure they're beat up. They're giving us everything they got. So it's commendable just the fight that they have... So just tip the cap and ask as much as they can give.”

Mitch Johnson on De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper, May 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't:Wemby on Fox and Harper not being 100%:

“It pains me to see them in pain. I trust that they're going to be healthy soon and come back. They should take care of their health. Like we did game 1, we're gonna have their back”

Victor Wembanyama on De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper, May 23, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: De'Aaron Fox on Victor Wembanyama, Stephon Castle, Dylan Harper
item.description:
“I let the game come to me. Sometimes I attack the game a little more. But, at the end of the day, those guys (Wembanyama, Castle and Harper) are extremely talented. They understand the game at an extremely high level, and it's easy to play with them.”

De'Aaron Fox on Victor Wembanyama, Stephon Castle, Dylan Harper, Apr 10, 2026. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Dylan Harper
item.description:
Wemby on Harper:

“I have zero doubt that if there was a redraft today we would take him. He's so good, socomposed... I'm so happy that Dylan is super young and can be there for years and years because I want to share the court with him for as long as possible.”

Victor Wembanyama on Dylan Harper, Mar 5, 2026. Source: reddit.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Dylan Harper
item.description:
“Him and his teammate Dylan Harper are playing some great ball. They’re one of my favorite teams to watch. But I see some of my game in Ace,”

Kevin Durant on Dylan Harper, Dec 26, 2024. Source: New York Post.
